intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. My flagship single-binary Rust desktop and web applications (Linux, macOS, and Windows .exe with chromeless desktop launch) are OpenRO v1.3.0 (Studio Copilot 3-pane Roblox Studio AI IDE with 95.5ms cold boot -93.5%, 89.3 MB RSS -22.5%, 1-click Monetization & Economy Codegen, 7-gate Ship Readiness Autopilot, Agent/Plan/Ask unified Luau diffs, OpenRoCompanion.lua Studio plugin, all 13 official MCP tools, and Rojo .zip export at 3,792 req/s), OpenBell v0.9.0 (Institutional Quant Terminal for Kalshi Trade API v2 with 1-click Full Quant Edge Audit 5-stage Go/No-Go funnel, causal lookahead-canary tests, fail-closed Hard Risk Rails disarmed on every boot, Emergency Kill Switch, Out-of-Sample Strategy Tournament, PAV Isotonic Calibration, and $500/Day Capital Scaling Engine), and Fleet v0.11.0 (Codex/Linear parallel coding-agent workbench with 15.4ms cold boot 10x faster, Wave Preflight & confirmation-gated Batch PR, Auto-Heal Failure Classifier, Goal-to-DAG planner, instant keyboard triage, Worktree Inspector, and Daily Dispatch Budget guardrails at 7,048 req/s), alongside Ergon v0.12.0 (Claude-Desktop employee agent desk with 1-click Save as routine, 1-click SHA-256 Client Pack .md export, multi-file batch workflow queue, modular Rust server at 6,047 req/s & 6.47ms p95, side-by-side .history/ diff preview & restore, and 12 workflows).
